title: The First Finite-Return Casepack: A Worked Case Showing Finite Re-Entry Under a Frozen Grammar
source_native_claims: First public paper in the GCD/UMCP corpus to make return explicit as a measured finite event under a frozen grammar, using one bounded local episode with a reference state, a wounded departure, and a candidate returned state.
Does not yet claim weld, seam closure, or earned continuity; establishes finite return as the necessary public step before those stronger burdens.
